/hr/ghcr.io-kubereboot-charts-kured-kube.doc: Kured (Kubernetes REboot Daemon) is a Kubernetes add-on that automates the process of rebooting nodes in your cluster. It integrates with the underlying operating system's package management system to identify when a reboot is necessary, and performs the reboot in a safe and controlled manner to minimize disruption to your applications.

0:
initContainers:
  - name: dind
    image: docker:29-dind
    securityContext:
      privileged: true
    restartPolicy: Always
    env:
      - name: DOCKER_TLS_CERTDIR
        value: /certs
    resources:
      requests:
        memory: 1Gi
      limits:
        memory: 8Gi
    volumeMounts:
      - name: docker-storage
        mountPath: /var/lib/docker
      - name: docker-certs
        mountPath: /certs
    startupProbe:
      exec:
        command:
          - sh
          - -c
          - docker --tlsverify --tlscacert=/certs/client/ca.pem --tlscert=/certs/client/cert.pem --tlskey=/certs/client/key.pem -H tcp://localhost:2376 info
      initialDelaySeconds: 5
      periodSeconds: 1
      failureThreshold: 30
containers:
  - env:
      - name: DEBIAN_FRONTEND
        value: noninteractive
      - name: DOCKER_HOST
        value: tcp://localhost:2376
      - name: DOCKER_TLS_VERIFY
        value: "1"
      - name: DOCKER_CERT_PATH
        value: /certs/client
      - name: FORGEJO_RUNNER_K8S_LOG_JOB_OUTPUT
        value: true
    image: ghcr.io/bjw-s-labs/forgejo-runner:ubuntu-24.04
    imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
    name: main
    resources:
      requests:
        memory: 1Gi
      limits:
        memory: 4Gi
    volumeMounts:
      - name: docker-certs
        mountPath: /certs
        readOnly: true
volumes:
  - name: docker-storage
    ephemeral:
      volumeClaimTemplate:
        metadata:
          labels:
             app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: forgejo-runner-codeberg
        spec:
          storageClassName: local-hostpath
          accessModes:
            - ReadWriteOnce
          resources:
            requests:
              storage: 5Gi
  - name: docker-certs
    emptyDir: {}
restartPolicy: Never

[supervisord]
nodaemon=true
logfile=/dev/stdout
logfile_maxbytes=0
pidfile=/tmp/supervisord.pid
loglevel=warn

[unix_http_server]
file=/tmp/supervisor.sock
chmod=0700

[supervisorctl]
serverurl=unix:///tmp/supervisor.sock

[rpcinterface:supervisor]
supervisor.rpcinterface_factory = supervisor.rpcinterface:make_main_rpcinterface

[program:api]
command=/usr/local/bin/node /app/server/dist/src/main
directory=/app/server
priority=20
autostart=true
autorestart=true
stopasgroup=true
killasgroup=true
stopwaitsecs=1
startsecs=5
startretries=3
stdout_logfile=/dev/stdout
stdout_logfile_maxbytes=0
stderr_logfile=/dev/stderr
stderr_logfile_maxbytes=0
environment=PORT="3001",DATABASE_URL="%(ENV_DATABASE_URL)s",JWT_SECRET="%(ENV_JWT_SECRET)s",NODE_ENV="production",OIDC_ENABLED="%(ENV_OIDC_ENABLED)s",OIDC_PROVIDER_NAME="%(ENV_OIDC_PROVIDER_NAME)s",OIDC_ISSUER_URL="%(ENV_OIDC_ISSUER_URL)s",OIDC_CLIENT_ID="%(ENV_OIDC_CLIENT_ID)s",OIDC_CLIENT_SECRET="%(ENV_OIDC_CLIENT_SECRET)s",DISABLE_INTERNAL_AUTH="%(ENV_DISABLE_INTERNAL_AUTH)s",APP_URL="%(ENV_APP_URL)s"

[program:web]
command=/bin/sh -c "until curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:3001/api/health >/dev/null 2>&1; do sleep 1; done; exec /usr/local/bin/node /app/web/server.js"
directory=/app/web
priority=10
autostart=true
autorestart=true
stopasgroup=true
killasgroup=true
stopwaitsecs=1
startsecs=10
startretries=3
stdout_logfile=/dev/stdout
stdout_logfile_maxbytes=0
stderr_logfile=/dev/stderr
stderr_logfile_maxbytes=0
environment=PORT="3000",HOSTNAME="0.0.0.0",SERVER_URL="http://127.0.0.1:3001",NODE_ENV="production"
